muxrtc.Sets the date, time and timezone your de:
Sets the date, time and timezone your device keeps. The notation setting chooses how the clock reads, covering twelve or twenty-four hour and the order of day and month.

Choosing Custom lets you write the layout yourself using a strftime format string, so %H:%M gives 14:30 and %a %d %b gives Tue 05 Aug. Anything strftime accepts will work, and an invalid string simply leaves the clock blank.

muxshader.Change the shader of your current select: Change the shader of your current selected content

muxshot.Lists the screenshots taken on this devi: Lists the screenshots taken on this device, newest first. Select one to view it full size, or remove any you no longer want. New screenshots appear here whenever you use the screenshot hotkey while content is running.
muxshot.Screenshots are saved here when you use: Screenshots are saved here when you use the screenshot hotkey while content is running.

muxsort.Chooses how this list is arranged, from: Chooses how this list is arranged, from alphabetical through to how recently or how often something was played. The order can apply just to this folder or to every folder at once.
muxsort.Set Content Explorer sorting level for C: Set Content Explorer sorting level for Collection items (100 top of list 1 bottom of list)
muxsort.Set Content Explorer sorting level for D: Set Content Explorer sorting level for Default items (100 top of list 1 bottom of list)
muxsort.Set Content Explorer sorting level for H: Set Content Explorer sorting level for History items (100 top of list 1 bottom of list)
muxsort.Set Content Explorer sorting level for i: Set Content Explorer sorting level for items tagged as %s (100 top of list 1 bottom of list)

muxspace.Answer this to show you meant to do it.\:
Answer this to show you meant to do it.

%s
muxspace.Everything on %s is about to go.\nAnythi:
Everything on %s is about to go.
Anything not backed up somewhere else is gone for good.
Everything on this storage will be lost.
muxspace.How much of the storage is currently tak: How much of the storage is currently taken up by files.
muxspace.How much room is left. Leaving a little: How much room is left. Leaving a little spare helps the card spread writes out and last longer.
muxspace.How much room the filesystem reports in: How much room the filesystem reports in total. This is usually a little under what the packaging claims, because the card reserves space for its own bookkeeping.
muxspace.How the storage is formatted. exFAT and: How the storage is formatted. exFAT and FAT32 are readable on any computer, while EXT4 keeps file permissions but needs Linux to read.
muxspace.Keeps file permissions, but only Linux c: Keeps file permissions, but only Linux can read it.
muxspace.Last chance.\nErase %s and format it as:
Last chance.
Erase %s and format it as %s?
muxspace.Reports how much room is used and free o: Reports how much room is used and free on each storage device attached to your system, so you can see at a glance where content is going.
muxspace.Suits large files and is still read by m: Suits large files and is still read by most computers.
muxspace.That was not what was asked for, so noth: That was not what was asked for, so nothing was changed
muxspace.The card muOS starts from. It holds the: The card muOS starts from. It holds the MUOS directory along with your content, saves and configuration.
muxspace.The date the card says it was made. A da: The date the card says it was made. A date in the future, or one long before the card was bought, is a warning sign.
muxspace.The kernel name for the partition this s: The kernel name for the partition this storage is mounted from.
muxspace.The manufacturer the card reports for it: The manufacturer the card reports for itself. Counterfeit cards often report a well known name that does not match how they behave.
muxspace.The product name the card reports for it: The product name the card reports for itself.
muxspace.The read mostly partition holding muOS i: The read mostly partition holding muOS itself. It does not grow with use and cannot be prepared.
muxspace.The result of the startup card check. An: The result of the startup card check. Anything below genuine means the card may not hold as much as it claims, and content written to it can come back corrupted.
muxspace.The second card slot, used purely for ex: The second card slot, used purely for extra content storage. Safe to prepare or swap out.
muxspace.This device cannot create any of the sup: This device cannot create any of the supported filesystems
muxspace.This storage is attached but nothing on: This storage is attached but nothing on it can be read. It is either unformatted or its filesystem is damaged, and preparing it will make it usable again.
muxspace.This will erase everything on %s and lea:
This will erase everything on %s and leave it as a single empty partition.
There is no way back once it starts.
muxspace.USB storage attached to the device. Remo: USB storage attached to the device. Removable, so treat anything on it as temporary.
muxspace.View the current used space of the mount: Visualizza lo spazio occupato dei dispositivi di archiviazione usati
muxspace.Works in the most places, but holds no s: Works in the most places, but holds no single file over 4GB.

muxstorage.%s will be wiped from secondary storage:
%s will be wiped from secondary storage and used from primary storage again.
Sync it first if you have not already.
muxstorage.All %d items will be wiped from secondar:
All %d items will be wiped from secondary storage and used from primary storage again.
Sync them first if you have not already.

muxtag.Change the tag of your current selected: Cambia la categoria del contenuto attualmente selezionata per metterla in primo piano
muxtag.Marks the content you selected with a ta: Marks the content you selected with a tag, such as completed or in progress, so it stands out in lists and can be filtered on later.
muxtag.Show only the content carrying the tag y: Show only the content carrying the tag you pick, or choose None to show everything again

muxtask.Runs the maintenance scripts kept on you: Runs the maintenance scripts kept on your device, covering clean-up, restoring defaults and toggling services on and off. Scripts report their progress as they run and say what changed once finished.
muxtask.Task scripts placed on your current stor: Task scripts placed on your current storage will appear here.

muxtester.Press DOWN + A to finish testing: Press DOWN + A to finish testing
muxtester.Press DOWN + B to finish testing: Premi GIÙ + B per terminare il test

muxtheme.Lists the themes installed on your devic: Lists the themes installed on your device. Select one to apply it and the interface changes immediately, covering colours, fonts, glyphs and wallpapers. Themes are installed from archives through the Archive Manager.
muxtheme.Themes install from archives through the: Themes install from archives through the Archive Manager.
muxtheme.This theme is protected from deletion!: This theme is protected from deletion!

muxthemedown.Lists themes available to download from: Lists themes available to download from the community. Select one to fetch and install it, then apply it from the theme list. A preview is shown for each so you can see how it looks before committing to it.

muxthemefilter.Filter to theme with a name containing l: Filtra per tema con un nome contenente il testo di ricerca.
muxthemefilter.Filter to themes for this device or all: Filter to themes for this device or all themes. All themes can work on any device but if the theme does not implement your devices resolution it will be letterboxed.
muxthemefilter.Filter to themes that let MustardOS hand: Filter to themes that let MustardOS handle translating text. Themes that use static images for the main menu will be filtered out.
muxthemefilter.Filter to themes that support HDMI resol: Filter to themes that support HDMI resolution 1280x720. Themes will still work on HDMI without support for 1280x720 but content will be letterboxed.
muxthemefilter.Filter to themes that support displaying: Filtra i temi che supportano la visualizzazione delle cartelle dei contenuti in un formato a riquadri
muxthemefilter.Narrows the theme list to those that sui: Narrows the theme list to those that suit your device, filtering by screen size and other properties so you only see themes that will fit.

muxthemeopt.Adjusts how the active theme is presente: Adjusts how the active theme is presented, covering scaling, resolution and which alternate colour scheme it uses.
muxthemeopt.Override the footer glyph render size in: Override the footer glyph render size in pixels (Default uses the theme value, Auto fits to item height, Native uses the actual size)
muxthemeopt.Override the grid glyph render size in p: Override the grid glyph render size in pixels (Default uses the theme value, Auto fits to the cell, Native uses the actual size)
muxthemeopt.Override the header glyph render size in: Override the header glyph render size in pixels (Default uses the theme value, Auto fits to header height, Native uses the actual size)
muxthemeopt.Override the list glyph render size in p: Override the list glyph render size in pixels (Default uses the theme value, Auto fits to item height, Native uses the actual size)
muxthemeopt.Override the maximum width of the left s: Override the maximum width of the left side option label as a percentage of content width (Default uses the theme value)
muxthemeopt.Override the number of visible list item: Override the number of visible list items (0 uses the theme default)
muxthemeopt.Override the theme footer bar height in: Override the theme footer bar height in pixels (Default uses the theme value)
muxthemeopt.Override the theme header bar height in: Override the theme header bar height in pixels (Default uses the theme value)

muxtimezone.Chooses the timezone your clock follows,: Chooses the timezone your clock follows, listed by region and city. Pick your region first, then the closest city to you.
muxtimezone.Select your preferred timezone: Seleziona il tuo fuso orario preferito

muxtweakadv.Fine tunes how the system behaves undern: Fine tunes how the system behaves underneath the interface, covering performance, storage handling and hardware options.

muxtweakgen.Covers the everyday settings, including: Covers the everyday settings, including sound, brightness, startup behaviour, language and the colours of the interface.
muxtweakgen.These are low level kernel parameters.\n:
These are low level kernel parameters.

Incorrect values can cause system instability or data loss!
muxtweakgen.These settings are intended for advanced:
These settings are intended for advanced users.

Changing them incorrectly may cause unexpected behaviour!

muxvisual.Changes the top title label in Explore C: Cambia l'etichetta del titolo in alto in Esplora Contenuti per mostrare il dispositivo di archiviazione attuale insieme al nome della cartella
muxvisual.Chooses what appears on screen, from the: Chooses what appears on screen, from the clock and battery through to folder counts, scrolling labels and which hints are shown.
muxvisual.Controls how labels scroll when they exc: Controls how labels scroll when they exceed half the display width - Disabled stops all scrolling, Continuous loops indefinitely, Bounce scrolls to the end then returns
muxvisual.Controls the intensity of the selection: Controls the intensity of the selection animation when navigating between list and grid items
muxvisual.Controls the scroll speed for labels - D: Controls the scroll speed for labels - Disabled turns off all scrolling, Slow and Fast adjust the animation speed with proportional pause durations
muxvisual.Controls the style of the selection anim: Controls the style of the selection animation applied when navigating between list and grid items
muxvisual.Gather content into folders by starting: Gather content into folders by starting letter, either one letter each or several letters together, with numbers kept separate
muxvisual.If enabled folders within content explor: If enabled folders within content explorer will be mixed in with other content alphabetically
muxvisual.Remove extra information from content la: Rimuovi informazioni extra dalle etichette dei contenuti - Questo NON rinomina i tuoi file, ma cambia solo come vengono visualizzati
muxvisual.Replaces the label of shortened content: Sostituisce l'etichetta abbreviata delle cartelle dei contenuti con etichette più appropriate
muxvisual.Select the animation used when dialogues: Select the animation used when dialogues, toast messages and help boxes appear
muxvisual.Toggle hidden content displayed in Explo: Abilita/disabilita la visualizzazione del contenuto nascono nella sezione Esplora Contenuti - Inserendo i caratteri '.' o '_' all'inizio di un file o una cartella questi vengono nascosti
muxvisual.Toggle the visibility of currently selec: Attiva/disattiva la visibilità del numero di file contenuti nel percorso corrente in Esplora Contenuti
Attiva/disattiva la visibilità del numero di cartelle contenute nel percorso corrente in Esplora Contenuti
